notes: §2002:14.8.47.3 GR28: a relative file opened I-O with random or dynamic access inserts records; the program sets the relative key to the record number and the WRITE releases the record at that number. Seed record 3 (OPEN OUTPUT, random access, RK=3: SEED-3 00); OPEN I-O on the ACCESS RANDOM connector with RK=1 -> RANDOM-IO-1 00; OPEN I-O on the ACCESS DYNAMIC connector to the same file with DK=5 -> DYNAMIC-IO-5 00 (no record at 1 or 5, so GR25b's '22' does not arise; 00 per GR10). Matched at --std 2002 with the pinned build of dc1f2dcce8 (g2_write_relative_io_insert).
